more_info.overview: Polyglycerol polyricinoleate is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include edible ices, cocoa and chocolate products as covered by directive 2000/36/ec, other confectionery including breath freshening micro-sweets, sauces. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Made by esterifying polyglycerol with condensed fatty acids from castor oil. It is a chemically processed ingredient with a plant-oil fatty-acid component.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The fatty-acid component comes from castor oil, but the polyglycerol feedstock is not specified. Vegan, vegetarian, halal and kosher suitability requires supplier information.
more_info.side_effects:
Assessed food-use estimates were below the limit.
Short human studies showed no significant adverse effect; a high-dose animal study supported the limit.
